title: Expose existing read-only Case Queue through authenticated first-party server projection
goal: Make the native CAP-INV-101 Case Queue projection consumable as an authenticated, server-authorized Class-0 HTTP read without trusting provider-supplied access flags or selecting production IAM/storage/Saved View backends.
invariants: Principal/tenant/environment scope is derived only from an authenticated host session, never the client, URL or input provider metadata.
Case, optional Incident and Finding data are independently permission checked server side; nested denied metadata never reaches query, projection or response.
The original first-party Case Queue projector is the only search/sort logic; request supports only one bounded literal q filter with no Case mutation, assignment, Saved View persistence or export.
Production identity provider, durable Case catalog, rate limiting, TLS and audit logging remain injected host responsibilities; this is not production deployment.
security_properties: Cross-tenant provider candidates reject the entire response; denied Cases and nested context are stripped before projection, including denial counts.
Unknown owner decisions and provider errors fail closed with generic messages; no partial output.
Responses are no-store, Vary Authorization, JSON-encoded and capped; only GET, no client-provided scope, membership or ACL.

migration.rationale: Read-only first-party HTTP adapter with host-supplied session, Case owner provider and authorizer; no canonical state mutation or persistence.

rollback.strategy: Revert optional native HTTP handler; existing standalone Case Queue projection and Timeline demo unaffected.
verification: No Case mutation or Saved View storage side effects

inputs: E10-INV-101F verified bounded read-only projection foundation
CAP-INV-101 canonical requirements for permission-filtered Case list and Class-0 search
Existing product-runtime/case-queue projection.go/types.go/saved_view.go, first-party server authorization patterns
outputs: Native Case Queue GET adapter using server-injected session/candidate/authorization interfaces
Exact per-Case and nested Incident/Finding read checks before existing Case Queue projection
Go HTTP integration tests against forged decisions, denied objects, foreign tenants and malformed client requests
acceptance_tests: Authorized GET with literal q returns only matching, server-authorized Case rows, without disclosure of denied Cases/Incidents/Findings or their counts.
Provider-supplied AccessDecision cannot grant access to a Case or nested context; exact scope cannot be overridden through requests.
Wrong method, client-supplied tenant/ACL, invalid query, absent session, owner failure or cross-tenant candidate fail closed without partial data.
Go tests and exact-head required engineering CI run; distinguish code/test, L2, GitHub approval, integration and production.

performance_budget.rationale: One bounded <=5000 candidate provider pass with <=1 object authorization per Case and per nested reference; native projection does bounded deterministic sorting; maximum JSON response 4 MiB.
metrics: <=5000 candidates; <=4MiB response; <=256 UTF-8 bytes literal query
Linear per-object auth checks plus existing native sorting

Behavioral HTTP tests include authorization, tenant, nested-denial, malformed query, no leakage or mutation
